ios.desc:
Shoot hoops everywhere with AR basketball!

Requires AR compatible device (with iOS 11 or later) and camera access.

AR GAMEPLAY BRINGS THE FUN TO YOU

* Take the hoops to the beach, park, or anywhere
* Augmented reality (AR) turns any flat surface into your court
* Play in endless or arcade mode
* Realistic 3D basketball & hoop graphics
* Amazing physics, shadows, and adaptive lighting
* Fun sound effects & music
* Haptic feedback when you score a basket
* Improve your shooting skills and become a star

HOW TO PLAY

* Walk around to find a surface
* Place your hoop on the surface
* Step back & look at the hoop
* Swipe up to toss the ball
* Score baskets and have fun

While playing outside, please stay stay alert of your surroundings.

COMPATIBLE DEVICES:

* iPhone SE
* iPhone 6s or newer
* iPhone 6s Plus or newer
* iPad Pro or iPad (2017)

Hoop Stars is designed, built, and maintained in California. We'd love to know how we can improve your experience, so please contact us at support@fastrobo.co or tweet us @FastRobo.

quotes.text:
Over weekends, I built an ARKit game for iOS 11 https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/hoop-stars/id1282112219

I'm still busy fixing issues & developing new features :)

ARKit itself may not be the most amazing framework ever, but the cool thing about AR is that people just get it. For example, my demo footage is here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tJlaUQA7Xic and it's very easy to grok

If you have any questions about ARKit, please don't hesitate to ask
